title: NPOV-Onset: a dated benchmark of neutral-point-of-view dispute onsets on English Wikipedia
description:
A dated benchmark of ~2,000 English Wikipedia neutral-point-of-view (NPOV) dispute onsets. Each event is localised by binary search to the exact revision that introduced the maintenance template (correcting for the ~26% of templates that are bot-dated), and paired with a topically and activity-matched never-tagged control. Released with the code for a seven-stage lead-time evaluation of whether articles drift away from neutrality before an editor flags them. Everything derives from public English Wikipedia revisions collected read-only through the MediaWiki Action API. See the datasheet (DATASHEET.md) for full composition, collection, and field documentation.

Tracking task: phab:T428896.
